sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 7 — Emergency Power Systems
sources.description: Governs emergency power system requirements including generator sizing, transfer switch requirements, and automatic startup for life safety systems.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Emergency Lighting and Backup Power Requirements
sources.description: Specifies when emergency power is required by occupancy type and building height. Minimum illumination levels for egress paths.

sources.label: RA 9514: Fire Code of the Philippines — Emergency Power for Fire Protection Systems
sources.description: Requires emergency/standby power for fire alarm systems, fire pumps, and smoke management systems in specified occupancies.
